summary: Implementation fully satisfies the saved worker-heartbeat readiness plan. HEAD adds the durable worker_heartbeats model, repository, migration, and exports; ControlWorker writes heartbeats from run_once and a periodic run_forever loop; /readyz exposes checks.worker with fresh, missing, stale, and unavailable worker heartbeat reason codes and includes the worker check in readiness; smoke reads checks.worker instead of checks.db and fails closed with SMOKE_WORKER_UNAVAILABLE when worker liveness is stale, missing, malformed, or unreachable; CLI output and docs carry worker/worker_reason evidence and no longer present worker_db_substrate as the liveness proof. Focused tests cover readyz healthy/missing/stale/unavailable paths, worker heartbeat writes and failure handling, smoke 503-body and fail-closed behavior, CLI evidence, and migration schema. Existing validation evidence records focused pytest, ruff, mypy, and coverage checks as passing, with full AWF/GitHub validation left to AWF after agent completion.
